run_triangulator_3d_pose: run the Triangulator class to compute 3D human keypoints from multiview 2D pose estimates
triangulate_ransac_keypoint: triangulate a single 3D keypoint from multiple camera views using RANSAC with reprojection error filtering
triangulate_linear_dlt: triangulate a 3D point from multiple views using direct linear transformation with confidence weighting
calc_reprojection_error: calculate the reprojection error matrix between projected 3D keypoints and original 2D detections
convert_homogeneous_euclidean: convert homogeneous coordinate points to euclidean coordinates for numpy arrays or torch tensors
